title: City Council District 5
statement: The launch of D1 expansion under the Oakland Alternative Response Initiative is a start, but East Oakland’s crime index at 1.17—nearly double the city’s 0.699—demands more than just programmatic checkboxes. Safety here isn’t a pilot; it’s survival. We’ll vote YES, but only if the monthly audits explicitly tie resource allocation to reducing violent crime disparities and empower community liaisons like Jerome Pittman to shape the on-the-ground model. East Oakland’s resilience has always been met with systemic abandonment—this expansion must break that cycle.
